tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, menus and kbd keys sitting on paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: code spans, table headers, footer band.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and section rules. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, cards, tags, kbd. Meets 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the secondary button border, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions and mono labels, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: neptune
tokens.usage: The brand. Primary button fill, links, focus ring, active state. As text, on paper, paper-raised and neptune-soft.

tokens.name: neptune-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind neptune text: accent tags, selected rows, highlights.

tokens.name: on-neptune
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a neptune fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every paper surface.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / shipped / online state. Always paired with a word. As text, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Warning, failure or breaking change. Always paired with a word. As text, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on an alert fill: the danger button. 5.7:1 (Paper), 9.2:1 (Deep).

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal and code-block ground. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Text on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-muted
tokens.usage: Prompts, comments and timestamps on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-accent
tokens.usage: Commands, paths and highlights on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / done state on term-bg: toast labels. Always with a word.

tokens.name: term-alert
tokens.usage: Warning or failure on term-bg: toast labels. Always with a word.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ship the smallest thing that proves the idea, then measure it.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Notes from a week of evals.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes. Italic serif only here.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Buttons, nav, tags, section eyebrows.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: System metadata strings, timestamps, version stamps.

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: Cover title on a 1920x1080 slide. Once per deck.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Slide headings, at the top margin on every content slide.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Auth, scoping and audit live in one place.
styles.usage: Leads, table cells, card text on slides.

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, table headers, footers, stamps on slides. Uppercase. 24px is the floor: label and meta both map here.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, tags, terminals. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, kbd keys.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and radio buttons only.

shadow.note: Neptune is flat. The one shadow is a hard offset, used for press and hover lift.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Hover lift on buttons and linked cards. No blur, ever.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: stroke-key
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of kbd keys and the focus ring.

layout.note: The page frame. Use through np-container and the components, not inline.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of page content, centred with auto margins.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the page container on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Side padding of the page container below bp-sm.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for reading text (Prose).

tokens.name: measure-short
tokens.usage: Max line length for leads under headings (Hero, SectionHead, Split).

breakpoint.note: Media queries cannot read CSS variables. These name the two widths bundle.css uses; keep them in sync.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Below this: display type drops one step, Feed rows stack, the container gutter narrows.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Below this: Nav collapses to Menu, Split rows stack, the Docs layout drops to one column.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Below this: the Docs layout hides its On this page column.

timing.note: Fast and stepped. Nothing eases in. prefers-reduced-motion removes the lift and the blink.

tokens.name: duration-step
tokens.usage: Hover lift and press on buttons and linked cards.

tokens.name: easing-step
tokens.usage: Every transition.

tokens.name: duration-blink
tokens.usage: Terminal cursor blink, the one ambient animation.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Nav phone menu and dropdowns.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their backdrop, such as search.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The toast stack. Above dialogs, so a result can land while one is open.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips. Above everything.
